sharedProposal.status: UNADOPTED AND UNSENT. Eight complete proposed mechanical procedures and sixteen authored examples. Every unsupported completion is explicitly NEW. No source card, ordinary spell review status, class access, runtime, balance or cosmology approval changes.
sharedProposal.casting: All eight retain Action and V/S/F. Their actual four ordinary class placements are rank 4 with base 7 RP, but repertoire and minimum class level remain independently required. Use the actual class engine, hand/focus/voice requirements, current RP and Dissonance surcharge, paid costs, cast-begin cadence and interrupt window. No legal observable target/placement means no commitment; hidden ineligibility after commitment is no refund or free diagnosis. A legal concentration cast ends incompatible old concentration at commitment even if countered. Spell attacks use d20 + PB + actual casting modifier; saves use DC 8 + PB + actual casting modifier. Saves are binary with no natural-die degree shift. No generic upcast, scaling, free Action or newly acquired source is supplied.
sharedProposal.geometry: NEW precise defaults for this group: declare fixed dimensions, orientation, origin and perceived placement before resolution. Every creature whose occupied space intersects the stated area and has the stated area-origin line of effect is eligible, including allies/caster unless the particular origin rule excludes them. A placement needs caster line of effect to its chosen point. Total barriers clip the affected region rather than being silently traversed. Snapshot each simultaneous area event before damage, including its actual cover and recipients; destroyed cover does not create another wave from that event. Future genuine pulses take new snapshots. No general selective ally exclusion, water/metal chain or structural damage follows from a damage type.
sharedProposal.damage: KEEP the reviewed pipeline. Roll each specified raw area expression once for that simultaneous event, not separately per recipient. Apply each recipient’s own save, typed defenses and actual prevention/sharing independently. A half-save floors each typed component before its own defenses. A mixed-type simultaneous hit remains one damage event with typed subamounts, one root for that original recipient and no artificial extra concentration/Wound triggers; genuinely later or separately triggered packets stay separate. Attack criticals double only the actual attack dice; a save or environmental packet cannot critically hit. Zero damage does not by itself erase an independent condition or future rider. Apply only source-qualified class hooks at their real hit/damage/cast stage and frequency.
sharedProposal.newClocks: NEW for this group: a stated one-minute field ends at an absolute deadline sixty elapsed seconds after completed resolution. At that deadline expire it before a same-time field pulse, voluntary use or entry; hence an immediate event plus future six-second pulses at +6 through +54 has ten opportunities, not eleven. Preserve that deadline through initiative entry, exit, reorder, extra turns, absence and suppression. A pulse schedule is source-owned elapsed time and does not require a creature turn, invent companion START/END events or grant Actions. A saved or fully prevented eligible damage exposure still spends its applicable exposure allowance. A suppressed scheduled pulse is lost, never queued. A removed, expired or countered field produces no later pulse.
sharedProposal.newRoundExposure: NEW spell-specific anti-duplication: where a card says family once per round, keep an actual target/spell-identity/category ledger across all owners, cast IDs and equivalent bodies. Use the current numbered combat round; outside initiative use the scene’s continuing six-second cycle established before the first relevant exposure. Crossing timing modes maps the still-open cycle to the current round and preserves its already spent entries until that cycle/round ends; do not reset at a cast, reentry, resurrection of a record ID, suppression or initiative transition. Simultaneous competing eligible exposures use original application order then stable source ID. Distinct spells and explicitly distinct categories do not silently merge. This is not a universal rewrite of other spells’ periodic rules.
sharedProposal.newEndBridge: NEW only for Wall of Fire’s nearby END check: use an actual creature regular-turn END, including a current turn, subject to its family round cap. An owner-attached companion instead uses its real original-owner regular attached-phase end. If no real turn/phase exists, use an END-only checkpoint every complete six seconds without granting actions, ordinary START/END benefits or recharge. On transition map the next unresolved checkpoint to the next actual regular END/attached-phase END, preserving completed checks, round history and the original absolute deadline. Extra turns add none.
sharedProposal.newGroundFireStartBridge: NEW for Inferno Wave’s physical ground-fire hazard only: a real creature regular START checks actual ground contact. For an owner-attached companion, use the beginning of its original owner’s regular attached phase after that phase’s required processing, without creating ordinary START benefits. With no real turn/phase, use one contact check per completed six seconds, beginning six seconds after ignition. Map the next unresolved check on transition, retaining prior exposures and every actual patch endpoint. Extra turns add no scheduled contact checks. Independently actual entry can qualify under the same target/family/round limit. These environmental packets are not fresh spells, casts or spell attacks; apply only actual source hooks that cover their real cause.
sharedProposal.persistence: Each field/rider carries actual owner, originating class/rank, cast ID, snapshotted save DC, geometry/recipient, event history and expiry. A dispel or suppression must qualify against that exact source. Suppression does not restart it, refund costs, repeat creation or restore lost concentration. New concentration obeys the existing one-concentration rule, not an invented per-spell allowance. Objects, corpses, ended summons and replacements are not interchangeable recipients. Creature-only damage grants no collateral attack on every carried item. Fire/cold/acid imagery alone supplies no harvestable substance, light level, condition, cooking/purification permission or magical repair.

records.procedure: Action; V/S/F; instantaneous wave, no concentration. KEEP 60-foot line and 6d6 fire. NEW: a straight line from the caster, five feet wide and five feet high, in a declared direction; being its origin alone does not include the caster. Stop at a total solid obstruction. Snapshot all eligible creatures, each making DEX for full 6d6 fire on failure or half on success, with one shared raw roll. The wave itself has no general object-damage packet. KEEP its distinct ground-ignition clause: after the snapshot, ignite genuinely exposed combustible ground/floor material intersecting this footprint, including dry surface vegetation or an actually burnable wooden surface. Bare stone, water, saturated ground and unsupported air supply no fuel. NEW finite small-fire completion: divide actual ignited footprint into at most twelve five-foot patches, each clipped to the line and its available fuel. Before applying a patch, record the real combustible substrate, the finite amount that actually ignites, its physical burn endpoint no later than sixty seconds after ignition, and actual extinguishing method. If available fuel burns out sooner, use that earlier endpoint; no invented fuel mass, structural HP loss or total floor collapse follows from the spell. Each patch is an ordinary physical flame, not a continuing spell or Core Burning applied to a creature. It remains until fuel/endpoint or real extinguishing, independently of caster concentration, dispel or suppression of other magic. NEW hazard: a creature in contact with its burning surface takes 1d6 fire without a save on first actual entry or its regular START there, at most once per Inferno-ground-fire family/target/round across all patches and owners. A creature eligible for the initial wave counts as exposed to this family for that same round even if its save/defenses prevent damage; it takes no second immediate ground packet. No creation pulse, airborne heat damage or extra-turn START is added. A wholly suppressed original cast creates neither wave nor ignition; suppression after actual ignition cannot unburn material. Real dousing or complete smothering can end a contacted patch; one adjacent creature may spend an Action using actual sufficient water, sand or a usable nonburning cover to extinguish one patch, with no roll and no fabricated equipment. A source effect such as Tidal Wave can extinguish the ordinary flames it genuinely contacts. NEW conservative fire boundary: these patches do not automatically spread or persist past their recorded endpoint. Continued/spreading environmental fire requires a separately established ordinary hazard and remaining real fuel, never a fresh spell packet or free manufactured stock. Reignition is possible only for actual remaining unburned material and never resets a current round exposure.
records.newChoices: NEW five-by-five-foot cross-section, DEX half, bounded actual-fuel ground patches, sixty-second maximum small-fire endpoints, 1d6 contact hazard and explicit extinguishing. Ground ignition is retained; Burning, structural destruction and fuel creation are not inferred.
workedCases: EV4-01-A: The line rolls 23 fire. A failed creature takes 23 before defenses; a successful one takes 11. Both were initial eligible recipients and cannot take a second ground-fire packet in that same round. Dry grass in the first two five-foot patches actually ignites; the stone next to it does not.

EV4-01-B: A recorded patch has real fuel lasting 18 seconds. A new creature entering at second 7 takes the shared current entry event’s 1d6, rolled 4; leaving and entering another Inferno patch in the same round adds nothing. Actual dousing at second 10 ends that patch; no future START packet occurs and no Burning cure is needed.

records.procedure: Action; range 60 feet; V/S/F. KEEP 4d6 bludgeoning in an area and 4d6 lightning to a nearby target each round. NEW resolve the contradictory Instantaneous label as one fixed twenty-foot-radius sphere with concentration up to sixty elapsed seconds. Choose a perceived center within range with line of effect; actual origin barriers clip each pulse. At creation and each source six-second pulse before expiry, all creatures presently inside with center line of effect make STR: failure receives a shared 4d6 bludgeoning, success half. NEW initial/periodic bludgeoning is family once per target per round across all Storm Sphere owners/casts. Entry, reentry, forced movement, extra turns and suppression ending are not additional bludgeoning triggers. There is no forced movement, difficult terrain, obscuration or object packet. NEW lightning control: while this sphere is active, on your own regular turn you may spend an available Bonus Action to fire one bolt at one creature you presently perceive, within sixty feet of the sphere center and with center-to-target line of effect. This includes the casting turn if a Bonus Action remains; a pulse never supplies that Bonus Action. Target and source are committed before the attack, with no post-roll substitution. Make one ranged spell attack using your actual modifier against target AC, applying cover from the sphere center and the ordinary attacker’s restrictions; a hostile creature within five feet of you still imposes the normal close-quarters ranged-attack rule when it qualifies. Merely being inside or next to the sphere grants no advantage. Hit deals 4d6 lightning; natural attack critical doubles only these bolt dice to 8d6. Miss deals none. The bolt is a consequence of the existing spell, not a new cast/payment/cadence event. NEW at most one bolt per source character per numbered round from this identity across casts; an extra turn, command transfer, recast or second Bonus Action cannot refresh it, and unused bolts are lost, not banked. Outside initiative use an actually available six-second turn-equivalent Bonus Action under the existing action budget, starting hostile combat in ordinary initiative before an attack; there are no free pre-initiative bolts. Loss of legal target, consciousness, source eligibility or concentration before resolution prevents the bolt, with spent committed budgets unrefunded. Suppression prevents use but preserves original deadline and already spent bolt history; a scheduled suppressed bludgeoning pulse is lost. No continuing caster-to-center range tether, mobile sphere, independent creature/vehicle turn, automatic enemy selection or class-companion command budget is created. Concentration ending/expiry/removal ends this field and all its unused future opportunities. Each committed creation pulse finishes its snapshotted recipients before a pulse-caused concentration loss removes future effects.
records.newChoices: NEW twenty-foot sphere, concentration sixty seconds, STR-half periodic bludgeoning, separate own-turn Bonus Action ranged lightning attack, sixty-foot center-based bolt range and persistent round caps. No extra actor or automatic bolt.
workedCases: EV4-08-A: The casting Action establishes the field at t=0. A creature fails the initial STR save against shared bludgeoning 13. With its own Bonus Action still available, the caster commits a bolt: natural 20 hits and rolls 8d6 lightning, separately from the earlier bludgeoning event. The caster has no further bolt that numbered round.

EV4-08-B: The field’s t=6 pulse occurs while the caster is unable to spend a Bonus Action but still legally concentrating through a specific applicable exception. Eligible creatures can face that genuine bludgeoning pulse; no lightning bolt fires automatically. A skipped bolt is not added to the next regular turn.

Define finite geometry, lifetime/concentration, area bludgeoning timing and each-round lightning opportunity; whether command/action/Bonus Action is required must be explicit NEW authoring. Define nearby distance from the sphere or caster, target perception and line of effect, attack/save and ordering of independently typed events. Specify target commitment, skipped unavailable opportunities, source caps, movement of the sphere if any and ending/suppression. No unlimited off-turn bolts, automatic hostile selection, free additional Actions, unprinted difficult terrain or banked missed attacks.

explicitJointIssues: Inferno Wave retains real ground ignition but adds a finite small-fire profile. Confirm its sixty-second maximum, no automatic spread, contact timing, real-fuel prerequisites and separation from creature Burning without replacing a larger independently established environmental fire.
Orb of Annihilation adds a narrow legal-object mode and explicit object-save bridge. The name grants no disintegration or artifact deletion; object profiles remain actual use prerequisites.

Freezing Rain and Storm Sphere replace contradictory Instantaneous metadata with explicit concentration fields. Their source-owned six-second pulses, initial exposure and cross-cast family caps need exact review, including timing-mode transitions.
Freezing Rain’s slippery ground adds difficult-terrain cost plus a bounded movement-triggered DEX/Prone check. This terrain is not an elemental Speed-control component for Balanced Elements.

Voltaic Detonation proposes separate DEX and CON saves, a ten-foot sphere and the existing hard-denial guard. Its one-turn endpoint and attached-companion mapping are explicit; lightning immunity does not automatically block Stunned.

Ice Storm keeps both full 4d6 components in one typed event and adds a finite nonconcentration magical terrain residual. Shared rolls and one event per recipient must remain distinct from separately typed defenses.

Wall of Fire preserves both printed 5d8 clauses as two possible real packets per round, with separate crossing/nearby family caps, two-sided heat, a DEX save each time and no opaque/physical wall. This potential throughput needs balance discussion, not an assertion of balance.

Vitriolic Sphere preserves the delayed 5d4 on both initial save outcomes using the same full/half factor. Compare explicitly with Acid Arrow’s different attack and delayed-damage procedure rather than importing an external familiar version.

Storm Sphere’s lightning needs the caster’s actual Bonus Action, one per numbered round, with a ranged spell attack and center-based cover. Its ordinary spell is separate from same-named class techniques and companion commands.

All eight keep original source dice, class ranks and repertoire gates. Existing lower-rank unusual ranges and approved procedures remain unchanged; these proposed choices await actual GPT discussion and separate exact review.

preparedCompleteRecord.name: Chain Jolt

operational.targets: Choose one or two distinct creatures or independently legal objects you perceive within 30 feet and line of effect. Each need only be within your range, not near the other target. Declare their resolution order at commitment; the same creature/object cannot receive both jolts.
operational.resolution: After the cast survives its interrupt window, make one ranged spell attack independently against each still-legal chosen target in declared order. Each hit deals an independently rolled 1d8 lightning; each miss deals nothing. Each attack has its ordinary attack-reaction opportunities and its own attack/damage event.
operational.effect: One cast supplies at most these two attacks. A lost or invalidated target receives no substituted jolt and provides no retargeting. One attack’s outcome does not change the other’s die or convert the spell into a freely bouncing chain.
operational.scaling: None. No automatic increase in damage, range, targets, duration, uses or magnitude.
operational.limitations: No automatic Stunned, Reaction denial, unselected secondary creature, extra reach or free ongoing link. Objects must be independently legal targets with actual object AC, durability and material/damage defenses. This spell grants no generic permission to target an unwilling creature’s worn/carried equipment, no invented object statistics and no automatic secondary equipment damage. Actual class/source access, repertoire, level, action availability, components, costs, concentration transitions, Dissonance/Refrain and cast/counter/outcome hooks follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. These actual rank-1 placements have base 2 RP; real source modifiers and strain surcharges still apply. V is audible, S requires the ordinary usable free hand or an actual exception, and F is the ordinary class focus. A legal cast commits payment and cast-begin consequences before its Counterspell window; later failure/countering refunds nothing and restores no displaced concentration. Spell attacks use d20 + PB + actual casting modifier against AC; natural 1 misses/natural 20 hits and doubles only actual attack damage dice. Saves use DC 8 + PB + actual casting modifier and binary-save rules. Actual target/area defenses and source-specific hooks retain their real trigger scopes. No automatic level scaling, generic upcast, new action budget or resource generation.
operational.designNotes: PRESERVED: Action, 30 feet, V/S/F and two targets for1d8 lightning each. NEW: up-to-two flexibility, independent ranged spell attacks/dice, creature/legal-object selection, and explicit fixed target order. No double allocation to one target or imported bounce-distance restriction.

Affect a10-foot-radius patch on ONE contiguous supporting surface associated with that center, with line of effect from the center. Initial creature targets are every creature actually standing on/physically supported by that eligible patch, including you/allies; no selective omission.
operational.duration: Instantaneous initial damage; difficult terrain up to one minute, no concentration. In initiative the maximum ends at the caster’s tenth future regular-turn START after application, excluding a start already underway/passed. Outside initiative it ends 60 elapsed seconds after application. Preserve the original regular/virtual marker or absolute deadline through initiative changes, extra turns, absence and travel; no timing-mode change resets the maximum.
operational.resolution: Each initially supported creature makes a Dexterity save. Roll3d6 bludgeoning once. Failure: full raw result; success: no damage; each creature’s actual defenses apply. Regardless of individual saves, the eligible patch becomes difficult terrain for its finite duration.
operational.effect: The patch is a magical movement-cost effect on existing ground, floor or platform, not permanent material alteration. Its source-defined support/line-of-effect topology does not propagate through walls, floors/ceilings to another storey, or onto disconnected/stacked platforms merely because they fit a3D radius. Air/open water supplies no qualifying supporting surface. A normal building floor can qualify without receiving structural damage. Moving through the patch uses ordinary difficult-terrain costs; flying creatures not using that surface do not incur its cost. Separate casts retain their own patches/deadlines, but identical overlapping difficult terrain does not multiply the cost.
operational.scaling: None. No automatic increase in damage, range, targets, duration, uses or magnitude.
operational.limitations: No recurring damage on later entry, Prone, structural cracking/collapse, excavation, rubble inventory, permanent terrain or physical difficult-terrain object survives ending. Initial creature damage and the shared terrain effect are separate, so a successful save prevents only that creature’s initial damage. operational.targets: One creature you perceive within 30 feet and line of effect.
operational.duration: Instantaneous damage plus a possible one-target-round Stunned rider, no concentration. The rider ends at the target’s first future regular-turn END after application, excluding the entire current target turn if already underway. Outside initiative its deadline is application +6 elapsed seconds. Preserve that original regular/virtual marker or absolute deadline across initiative changes, absence and extra turns; no change of timing mode refreshes it.
operational.resolution: The still-legal creature automatically takes 4d6 force, with no attack or damage save. After that packet, if it remains a legal creature and the combined source-character/target/encounter hard-control allowance is available, it makes a Constitution save solely against Stunned. Failure attempts actual Stunned under its defenses; success does not establish Stunned. If the allowance is already unavailable, skip this Stun save; damage still resolves. Do not manufacture a postmortem save or condition if damage ended creature eligibility.
operational.effect: Force defenses and Stunned/control defenses are independent. Damage reduced to 0 does not itself prevent the available Stun procedure. Spend the shared hard-control allowance only when Stunned is actually established; prevention or a successful save spends no new allowance. Ending/removing Stunned does not refund already-spent history. Use actual Stunned consequences and the stated finite endpoint.
operational.scaling: None. No automatic increase in damage, range, targets, duration, uses or magnitude.
operational.limitations: The CON save does not negate or halve the prior force damage. No pull, collision damage or other positional movement comes from the name. A blocked hard component supplies no invented soft fallback, new allowance or refund. No automatic level scaling, generic upcast, new action budget or resource generation.

preparedCompleteRecord.name: Shatter

operational.targets: Choose a perceived point within 10 feet and line of effect. The initial area is a 10-foot-radius sphere around it. After interruption but before any damage, fix one snapshot of all eligible creatures, ordinary nonmagical discrete objects and bounded structural sections within the sphere with center line of effect.
operational.duration: Instantaneous, no concentration; actual damaged objects retain ordinary damage consequences.
operational.resolution: Roll one shared 3d8 thunder base and one shared additional 1d8 thunder object bonus. Each affected creature makes a Constitution save: failure takes the base; success takes half the base, rounded down. Creatures never receive the object bonus. Each eligible object or selected structural section takes base plus bonus as ONE grouped thunder packet, without a save, using its actual durability/material/damage defenses. Apply recipient defenses independently; do not turn the four damage dice into separate packets.
operational.effect: Eligible objects are ordinary nonmagical objects that are unattended, caster-held, or deliberately offered/exposed by willing holders; hostile worn/carried inventory is not automatically included. For each actual distinct large structural whole or terrain feature, select at most one contiguous exposed section wholly within the original sphere and bounded by a 5-foot cube. Use the eligible section containing its line-of-effect-reachable point nearest the spell center. Resolve equivalent nearest-point ties by stable neutral geometry/order fixed before damage, not caster choice or post-damage Director optimization. The Director determines actual structural identity and hidden boundaries without revealing them merely because the spell was cast. Arbitrarily naming bricks/panels/floorboards does not multiply one structure’s packets. A genuinely separate freestanding object remains independent. A large discrete object beyond the damage scale of its actual durability rules receives damage only to its legal affected section, not automatic transfer through the entire object. Fix all recipients and sections before any packet; destroying cover cannot expose new targets or cause another scan. Actual later support/collapse/falling consequences follow their own rules. Initial area recipients are a snapshot at resolution, with no selective omission or later entry damage. Apply the stated geometry and line of effect from the origin/center before damage removes cover; allies and caster are included only when the card actually includes their occupied space. Roll the stated raw area damage once, then apply each recipient’s save and defenses independently. Halved damage rounds down before individual defenses. Distinct recipients retain separate damage packets and callbacks. No attack critical applies to area save damage.
operational.scaling: None. No automatic increase in damage, range, targets, duration, uses or magnitude.
operational.limitations: The short 10-foot point range and separate 10-foot radius both apply. No damage extends outside the selected section/sphere, no automatic whole-building collapse or propagation is granted, and no Deafened, construct vulnerability, magic-item suppression or named shattered condition is added. No one can choose a concealed load-bearing element or optimize sections after damage outcomes. Actual class/source access, repertoire, level, action availability, components, costs, concentration transitions, Dissonance/Refrain and cast/counter/outcome hooks follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. These actual rank-2 placements have base 3 RP; actual source modifiers and strain surcharges still apply. V is audible, S requires the ordinary usable free hand or an actual exception, and F is the ordinary class focus. A legal cast commits payment and cast-begin consequences before its Counterspell window; later failure/countering refunds nothing and restores no displaced concentration. Spell attacks use d20 + PB + actual casting modifier against AC; natural 1 misses/natural 20 hits and doubles only actual attack damage dice. Saves use DC 8 + PB + actual casting modifier and binary-save rules. Actual defenses and source-specific hooks retain their real trigger scopes. No automatic level scaling, generic upcast, new action budget or resource generation.

NEW: perceived point/sphere, CON half for creatures, shared +1d8 for legal nonmagical objects in one grouped packet, fixed pre-damage snapshot and deterministic bounded structural section procedure.

completeCurrentEnvelope.protectedInterfaceOriginal: Once per turn, spend 1 Blood Gauge while casting to prevent 1 Dissonance; the Agent routes Weave strain through blood rather than gaining free casts.
completeCurrentEnvelope.rpAuthority: Explicit fallback: Cleric CoreV2 curve ×0.5, halves upward
engine: Blood Gauge (BG) starts and ends each encounter at 0, capacity 3; Spill Control raises capacity 6 while known. Once on your own regular turn, a weapon attack that damages a hostile living creature grants 1 BG. Hemorrhage Slash uses this same trigger, not an additional one. Explicit critical/kill/refund features can add more, but total BG gained is capped 2 per round. Self-inflicted damage, allies, summons, helpless captives and repeated damage to a corpse never generate BG. Blood is an encounter resource, not a currency carried into rest.

Dexterity governs weapon attacks; Intelligence governs hemomancy save DC and M. S scales from Crimson Agent class level. A weapon technique includes only its printed attacks, with normal weapon die plus Dexterity (or Strength when that weapon requires it). No free attack is implied by attack-speed wording. Class BG and RP are separate. Once per turn when casting an ordinary spell, optionally spend 1 BG to prevent 1 of that cast's Dissonance gain, minimum 0; never reduce RP this way.

Your Bleed is a physical ongoing effect on a living, non-bloodless creature: 1d4 damage at the start of each of its next 3 turns, then ends. It is not a new attack and generates no BG or procs. Refresh duration instead of stacking; Blood Echo expressly allows two independent instances, maximum. An Action by the victim or an adjacent creature using a healer's kit ends all your Bleeds on that victim. Apply physical resistance/immunity normally. Track remaining ticks and creator per instance. Allied healing versions from Bloodweaver cost RP and never count as hostile Bleeds for detonation, spreading or generation.

One Blood Mark at a time on a living target with your Bleed, except Phantom Strike, which explicitly may apply the mark without Bleed. It does not add a free Bleed. Marks last 5 of your regular turns, expire on encounter end or if the target dies, and never create damage by themselves. Rupture requires the target still within 60 ft and line of effect; it spends the mark. A mark does not defeat cover, planar boundaries or bloodlessness. Bloodtrail has its own tracking limits.

Veinweaves are self buffs unless their card expressly allows an ally. They require concentration and one may be active. Crimson Harmony is an explicit exception permitting two Veinweaves as one linked concentration burden; a failed concentration check ends both. A non-Veinweave concentration effect replaces the whole group. BG is spent on activation; no upkeep unless printed. Damage-sharing is redirection before mitigation, not extra damage: apply each recipient's own defenses once and never redirect the redirected portion again.

The healing, execution and denial text below deliberately bounds the source's vague percentage/instant-kill claims. HP sacrificed is direct loss, bypasses temporary HP and defenses, cannot be redirected, and cannot reduce the donor below 1. Only a willing ally can donate. HP sacrifice is never damage for class triggers. No class feature here restores the dead or removes Wounds.

At level 1 learn the core Blood Gauge/Bleed rules automatically. Blood Mark and Veinweaver's Core remain selections; Quickblood can be selected and used without a second unlock tax. Veinweaver's Core improves that foundation as printed. Standard scheduled acquisition applies. Bloodbound Edge is automatic 9. At 10 choose Bloodweaver, Shadow Operative or Thirstborn; its Final Cut is automatic 20. Duplicate Hemostasis names are separate Arch and Bloodweaver IDs.

Capacity clarification: Blood Gauge automatically reaches capacity 6 at class 9. Spill Control allows reaching 6 early but never raises the cap above 6. This new explicit gate ensures a later 5-BG Final Cut can be used without an optional capacity selection. Gain cap 2/round and encounter reset 0 still apply.
workedExample: Bard-style example becomes Agent 5: DEX 16, INT 14, S 2, M 2, BG 0/cap 3, full class RP. Select Hemorrhage Slash, Quickblood, Blood Mark, Shroud at 1; Blood Tithe and Vital Targeting at 2; Rupture and Spill Control at 3. Capacity is now 6.
Turn 1: Hemorrhage Slash hits for ordinary weapon damage+2d6, applies Bleed, and gains 1 BG (not 2). Bonus Action Blood Mark pays 1 BG: balance 0. Target takes its first 1d4 Bleed on its next turn.
Turn 2: ordinary weapon attack hits and gains 1 BG. Keep the mark and save resources; Bleed ticks independently and grants no BG.
Turn 3: a second weapon hit gains 1 BG: balance 2. Bonus Action Quickblood spends 1 BG: balance 1. It gives movement, not another attack.

Turn 4: Rupture is an Action, pays 1 BG: balance 0 and consumes the mark. Target fails CON: takes(S+1)d8=3d8. Rupture is not a weapon hit, so it generates no replacement BG. Any remaining Bleed continues.
After the encounter BG becomes 0. Blood Tithe's used short-rest charge and spent RP do not refresh without an actual rest.
balanceQuestions: Does early setup take too many turns for one mark?
Can Bloodweaver protect without sacrifice loops or infinite healing?
Are denial and execution limits sufficient against bosses and multiclass dips?

cards.name: Arterial Cut
cards.effect: A critical weapon hit applies your Bleed. If it already has your Bleed, extend one instance by 2 ticks, maximum 5 ticks remaining. This damage never generates further BG.

source.originalText: Arterial Cut: Critical hits apply Bleed for 3 turns; Bleed duration +2 turns.

cards.name: Blood Tithe
cards.rangeAndTarget: Self after a hostile bleeding creature dies within 30 ft
cards.effect: Regain HP equal to M+class level after a creature bearing your Bleed dies. It must have been an active hostile combatant; no ally, summon, captive or corpse farming.

source.originalText: Blood Tithe: Killing a bleeding target restores 10% of max HP.

cards.name: Veinweaver's Core
cards.effect: You can dismiss a Veinweave without an action and switch to another known Veinweave using its normal activation. Once/short rest reduce the BG cost of one Veinweave by 1, minimum 1. The basic one-Veinweave capacity is part of your engine, not locked behind this selection.

source.originalText: Veinweaver's Core: Unlocks use of Veinweaves (1 active at a time).

cards.name: Vital Targeting
cards.effect: Add S damage to a weapon hit against a target that has not perceived you or is within 5 ft of another conscious hostile-to-it ally. This is flat damage, not a critical die, and requires an actual weapon hit.

source.originalText: Vital Targeting: +15% damage to flanked or unaware enemies.

cards.name: Shroudstep
cards.effect: After taking the Hide Action and moving at least 10 ft while hidden, gain+1 AC. You still need valid concealment and a successful ordinary Stealth check; this feature does not grant invisibility.

source.originalText: Shroudstep: After using stealth movement, gain +10% dodge for 1 turn.

cards.name: Hemorrhage Slash
cards.effect: Make one weapon attack. On hit add S d6 damage of the weapon type and apply Bleed. The usual once/turn hit trigger grants 1 BG; this card grants no separate BG.

source.originalText: Hemorrhage Slash: A precise strike that deals moderate damage and applies Bleed status to the target, generating 1 Blood Gauge point.

cards.name: Veinweave: Quickblood
cards.effect: Start a Veinweave: gain+10 ft Speed and ignore nonmagical difficult terrain. Once during its duration you may draw or stow one weapon without using your object interaction. It grants no attacks or Actions.

source.originalText: Veinweave: Quickblood: Consume 1 Blood Gauge point to increase your movement and attack speed by 15% for 3 turns.

cards.name: Blood Mark
cards.rangeAndTarget: One living target with your Bleed within 60 ft
cards.effect: Apply your Blood Mark. Replaces your previous mark without detonating it. The mark enables Rupture and printed mark interactions; it deals no automatic damage and does not grant vision.

source.originalText: Blood Mark: Apply a magical mark to a bleeding target that lasts for 5 turns. The mark can be detonated for additional effects.

cards.name: Shroud
cards.duration: Until end next turn or attack/cast/bright light
cards.effect: Become invisible while in dim light or darkness. Attacking, casting a spell or entering bright light ends it. You must still Hide to conceal your location. Audible movement can reveal your position.

source.originalText: Shroud: Enter stealth mode, becoming invisible to enemies until you attack or move into bright light. Limited uses per encounter.

cards.name: Vital Sense
cards.rangeAndTarget: Living creatures within 60 ft, excluding total cover
cards.effect: Sense presence and approximate direction, not identity or thoughts. Once during this minute, gain advantage on one weapon attack against a sensed creature you can otherwise legally target. This does not change critical range.

source.originalText: Vital Sense: Heighten your senses for 1 minute, allowing you to detect the presence of living creatures within 60 feet and see their vital points more clearly (+10% critical hit chance).

cards.name: Blood Echo
cards.effect: Your Bleed can have two independent instances on a creature; a third application refreshes the oldest. Once on each of your turns add 1 to one Bleed instance's next tick. Never spread or detonate more instances than actually exist.

source.originalText: Blood Echo: Bleeds now stack twice and deal +10% more damage.

cards.name: Bio-Alchemical Flow
cards.effect: Activating a self-only Veinweave does not itself end your hidden state or Shroud. Its normal visible effects may reveal you; attacks, spells and other hostile effects still break hiding normally.

source.originalText: Bio-Alchemical Flow: Veinweaves do not break stealth.

cards.name: Spill Control
cards.effect: Blood Gauge capacity rises from 3 to 6. Gain rate is unchanged. This replaces, rather than adds to, the old cap. No BG is granted merely by learning it.

source.originalText: Spill Control: Max Blood Gauge increased to 6.

cards.name: Rupture Trigger
cards.rangeAndTarget: Up to 2 other enemies within 5 ft of ruptured mark
cards.effect: After Rupture damages its marked target, choose up to 2 other living enemies nearby. Each makes CON save; on failure apply one Bleed. These applications do not trigger Rupture again or grant BG.

source.originalText: Rupture Trigger: Detonating a Blood Mark causes AoE Bleed in a small radius.

cards.name: Crimson Flow
cards.effect: After spending BG, gain+5 ft Speed. Your next weapon damage roll before end next turn adds 1. Repeated expenditures refresh rather than stack; no attack-speed or additional-Action benefit.

source.originalText: Crimson Flow: Using Blood Gauge grants +10% movement and attack speed for 2 turns.

cards.name: Crimson Harmony
cards.effect: You may sustain two Veinweaves as one concentration group. Both pay full costs and use normal activations; failing concentration ends both. Identical Veinweaves never stack, and no ordinary concentration spell can join this group.

source.originalText: Crimson Harmony: Maintain 2 Veinweaves simultaneously.

cards.name: Bloodbound Edge
cards.rangeAndTarget: Up to 3 enemies with your Bleed within 30 ft
cards.effect: End up to 2 of your Bleed instances per target. Each takes 1d4 per remaining tick, maximum S d4 per creature, ignoring resistance but respecting immunity. This replaces their future ticks and grants no BG, healing or kill-trigger benefit.

source.originalText: Capstone – Bloodbound Edge: Once per rest, convert all Bleeds on enemies to instant True Damage.

cards.name: Veinweave: Bloodshield
cards.effect: Start Bloodshield Veinweave. Gain temporary HP equal to class level+M. Once while they remain, use Reaction to reduce damage to yourself by S. No self-damage refund or BG is generated.

source.originalText: Veinweave: Bloodshield: Consume 2 Blood Gauge points to create a protective barrier that absorbs damage equal to 20% of your maximum health.

cards.name: Rupture
cards.effect: Target makes CON save: (S+1)d8 necrotic on failure, half on success. The mark ends either way; existing Bleed remains. Damage from this technique is not a weapon hit and grants no BG.

source.originalText: Rupture: Detonate a Blood Mark on a target, dealing significant damage and consuming the mark.

cards.name: Bloodtrail
cards.rangeAndTarget: One living target with your Bleed within 30 ft
cards.effect: Know the direction to the target while within 1 mile on the same plane. Total distance and a trail are not shown. Lead barriers or effects that block divination block this sense; it grants no attack advantage or targeting through cover.

source.originalText: Bloodtrail: Mark a bleeding target, allowing you to track them perfectly for 1 hour regardless of distance or obstacles.

cards.name: Veinweave: Sensory Theft
cards.rangeAndTarget: One living creature with your Bleed within 60 ft
cards.effect: Target makes WIS save. Failure lets you see and hear through it while it remains within 1 mile on the same plane; you are blind/deaf to your own surroundings. It repeats save at the end of each of its turns and the first time each round it takes damage. No control or thought reading.

source.originalText: Veinweave: Sensory Theft: Consume 2 Blood Gauge points to briefly experience what a bleeding target sees and hears.

cards.name: Hemostasis
cards.effect: End all Bleed on the target and restore S d6+M HP, regardless of number of ticks removed. You cannot create extra healing by inflicting extra Bleed. Works even if no Bleed is present, at the same RP cost.

source.originalText: Hemostasis: Stop all bleeding effects on yourself or an ally, converting each remaining turn of Bleed into a small amount of healing.

cards.name: Bloodbond
cards.effect: Create Bloodbond while both remain within 30 ft. When ally takes damage, you may use Reaction to redirect floor(one-quarter of pre-mitigation damage) to yourself; each recipient applies its own defenses once. Once/round when a paid technique heals you, ally gains M temporary HP. No recursive transfers.

source.originalText: Bloodbond: Link with an ally; share 25% incoming damage and transfer 10% healing to them.

cards.name: Hemostasis
cards.rangeAndTarget: One willing living ally in range of your Bleed application
cards.effect: You may replace a new Bleed application on that ally with healing 1d4 at start of its next 3 turns. Pay extra RP even if original application was free. One such healing effect per target; it cannot spread, detonate, generate BG or trigger healing loops.

source.originalText: Hemostasis: Bleeds applied to allies now heal them instead.

cards.name: Protective Flow
cards.rangeAndTarget: Allies actually affected by your Veinweaves
cards.effect: An affected ally gains+1 to saves and reduces each damage instance by 2, minimum 0. This benefit does not stack across Veinweaves or Agents. Self-only Veinweaves cannot be extended merely by this passive.

source.originalText: Protective Flow: Allies affected by your Veinweaves gain 10% DR and +1 to all saves.

cards.name: Veinlock Tether
cards.rangeAndTarget: Willing linked ally within 30 ft being damaged
cards.effect: While your Bloodbond or Vitality Link is active, redirect up to S+M damage to yourself before mitigation. This is an alternative to Bloodbond's quarter-sharing reaction, not an additional redirection. Redirected damage cannot be redirected again.

source.originalText: Veinlock Tether: Form a damage-sharing link with an ally for 3 turns.

cards.name: Crimson Pact
cards.rangeAndTarget: Up to 3 bleeding enemies and 6 living allies within 30 ft
cards.effect: End your Bleeds on chosen enemies; each makes CON save against 4d8 necrotic, half on success. Each chosen ally regains 4d8+M HP and gains 10 temporary HP. Use one shared roll per damage/healing effect; healing does not multiply by enemies or remaining ticks.

source.originalText: Final Cut – Crimson Pact: Detonate all enemy Bleeds to heal nearby allies and grant them barriers. (1/day)

cards.name: Transfusion
cards.cost: 2 RP; sacrifice up to class level HP
cards.effect: Lose K real HP, at least 1, without falling below 1. Ally regains K+floor(K/2) HP. Loss bypasses defenses and cannot trigger BG, damage-sharing or healing refunds. The RP/use limit remains even if little healing is possible.

source.originalText: Transfusion: Transfer health from yourself to an ally, healing them for 150% of the health sacrificed.

cards.name: Veinweave: Vitality Link
cards.effect: Start Vitality Link Veinweave. Once/round when you restore real HP with a paid Agent technique, linked ally regains M HP if within 30 ft. This secondary healing never triggers another link. Gain+1 AC while adjacent to that ally; no spell buffs or resources are copied.

source.originalText: Veinweave: Vitality Link: Consume 3 Blood Gauge points to link with an ally, sharing beneficial effects and healing for 3 turns.

cards.name: Blood Ward
cards.rangeAndTarget: Fixed 10 ft radius centered within 30 ft, up to 3 allies
cards.effect: Choose acid, cold, fire, lightning or necrotic. Selected allies within the zone gain resistance to that damage type. Leaving loses the benefit; reentering restores it. Identical resistance does not stack. This is not a Veinweave.

source.originalText: Blood Ward: Create a protective circle using blood magic that shields allies within from certain types of damage or effects.

cards.name: Purify Blood
cards.effect: End Poisoned and one nonmagical disease. Magical disease needs a successful INT ability check against its stated treatment DC, or DC 15 if absent; failure spends the cost. No curse, Wound, death or Corruption removal.

source.originalText: Purify Blood: Remove poison, disease, or other blood-borne afflictions from a target.

cards.name: Lifewell
cards.rangeAndTarget: Up to 3 living allies within 15 ft
cards.effect: Spend K BG. At start and on each of your next 2 turns, use Bonus Action and pay 1 RP to pulse healing: each chosen ally still within 15 ft regains 1d8+K HP. Without maintenance it ends at turn end. Total 3 pulses; no triggers create more BG.

source.originalText: Lifewell: Ultimate ability that converts all your remaining Blood Gauge into a powerful healing aura for allies.

cards.name: Ghost Vein
cards.effect: A weapon hit made from hidden ignores resistance to that weapon's damage type for this hit. Immunity remains. This does not bypass armor or make the attack automatically hit.

source.originalText: Ghost Vein: Attacks from stealth ignore 25% of target resistances.

cards.name: Blackout Agent
cards.rangeAndTarget: Attacker within 30 ft that missed you
cards.effect: Attacker makes CON save; failure Blinded. Requires it can see you. Each creature becomes immune to your Blackout Agent until encounter end after resolving this save, preventing repeated blind-lock.

source.originalText: Blackout Agent: Dodging an attack blinds the attacker for 1 turn.

cards.name: Ghostflow Reflexes
cards.effect: Gain+1 AC. Once/round after a Veinweave starts, shorten one OTHER positive Agent cooldown by 1; this uses that ability's reset allowance. It grants no critical immunity, actions or per-rest uses.

source.originalText: Ghostflow Reflexes: While Veinweave is active: +5% dodge, cooldowns -1, +10% crit resistance.

cards.name: Veinjammer
cards.rangeAndTarget: One creature damaged by your Bleed
cards.effect: After a Bleed tick, choose that victim: Speed reduced 5 ft, minimum 0, and its next concentration save takes-1. Nonstacking; does not remove an Action or prohibit spellcasting.

source.originalText: Veinjammer: Bleeds reduce enemy casting and action speed by 10%.

cards.name: Total Silence
cards.effect: Each makes CON save. Failure prevents verbal spellcasting and Reactions, and suppresses one passive bonus to AC or attack rolls chosen from an observed effect. It never removes innate anatomy, immunities, legendary rules or class resource pools. Success prevents all effects; no whole-sheet passive disable.

source.originalText: Final Cut – Total Silence: AoE disables all enemy passives and silences for 2 turns.

cards.name: Phantom Strike
cards.rangeAndTarget: One enemy in weapon reach; must be hidden from it
cards.effect: Make one weapon attack with advantage. On hit add S d6 damage and apply a mark without its usual BG cost, even if not already bleeding. The mark replaces your old mark; no free Rupture occurs. Normal hit BG gain still capped.

source.originalText: Phantom Strike: Attack from stealth with increased critical chance and apply a Blood Mark automatically.

cards.name: Veinweave: Shadow Meld
cards.effect: Start Shadow Meld Veinweave: advantage on Stealth and invisible while motionless in dim light/darkness. Moving removes invisibility until start next turn; attacking or casting ends the Veinweave. No concealment against blindsight or effects that expressly reveal invisibility.

source.originalText: Veinweave: Shadow Meld: Consume 3 Blood Gauge points to become nearly undetectable for 1 minute, gaining enhanced stealth capabilities.

cards.name: Disrupt Flow
cards.effect: CON save: failure prevents Reactions and gives disadvantage on its next spell attack. If concentrating, make an additional normal concentration save versus your class DC. This never disables all special abilities or guarantees a failed concentration check.

source.originalText: Disrupt Flow: Temporarily disable a target's special abilities by disrupting their vital energies.

cards.name: Blood Cipher
cards.rangeAndTarget: One willing or restrained living target with your Bleed touched
cards.effect: Target makes WIS save unless willing. On failure learn one factual sensory memory from the last 24 hours about a stated event; the target chooses a relevant memory if several exist. Success yields no information. No beliefs, absolute truth or unrelated secrets are guaranteed.

source.originalText: Blood Cipher: Extract information directly from a bleeding target's blood, potentially learning secrets or weaknesses.

cards.name: Blackout
cards.effect: Create magical darkness blocking ordinary sight and darkvision. You can see within it up to 30 ft. Creatures can leave normally; no automatic damage, surprise or advantage when another sense locates you. Enemies still act and make saves normally.

source.originalText: Blackout: Ultimate ability that creates a zone of magical darkness where only you can see clearly, granting significant advantages.

cards.name: Blood Frenzy
cards.effect: Add 1 to direct weapon damage per hostile creature bearing your Bleed, maximum 3. Applies once per hit, not per Bleed instance. Secondary Bleed, copies and explosions gain no bonus.

source.originalText: Blood Frenzy: +5% damage per enemy actively bleeding (max +25%).

cards.name: Hemorrhagic Plague
cards.rangeAndTarget: One new living enemy within 5 ft of a Bleed victim
cards.effect: After one of your Bleeds ticks, pay 1 BG; new target makes CON save. Failure applies one Bleed. A spread instance cannot spread again. This grants no BG and does not duplicate marks or immediate damage.

source.originalText: Hemorrhagic Plague: Bleeds automatically spread to nearby enemies every 3 turns.

cards.name: Pain-to-Power Conduction
cards.rangeAndTarget: One enemy within 5 ft after it damages you
cards.effect: End one active Veinweave. Chosen enemy makes CON save: failure takes S d4 necrotic and Bleed; success takes half immediate damage only. On failure by 10 it is Frightened until end next turn. No resource refund.

source.originalText: Pain-to-Power Conduction: Veinweaves explode when struck, dealing AoE Bleed and minor Fear.

cards.name: Carrion Conductor
cards.rangeAndTarget: One fresh hostile living-combatant corpse within 30 ft
cards.effect: Mark the corpse once; on activation or before expiry use Reaction to burst it. Up to 3 enemies within 5 ft make DEX saves: S d6 necrotic, half on success. Corpse cannot be reused, raised by this effect or provide BG/kill triggers.

source.originalText: Carrion Conductor: Corpses leave behind blood pools that explode for AoE damage.

cards.name: Veinburst Requiem
cards.rangeAndTarget: Up to 6 enemies with your Bleed within 30 ft
cards.effect: Spend K BG and end your Bleeds on targets. CON save: (S+K)d8 necrotic, half on success. A target failing by 10 with remaining HP no greater than your class level falls to 0; ordinary death rules follow. No percentage-based automatic boss execution or BG refund.

source.originalText: Final Cut – Veinburst Requiem: Detonates all Bleeds and Blood Gauge effects in range. Enemies under 25% HP are instantly executed. (1/day)

cards.name: Exsanguinate
cards.effect: CON save: (S+1)d8 necrotic, half on success; add 1d8 if it has your Bleed. If it fails and actually takes damage, regain 1 BG within the common gain cap. The refund cannot pay activation costs retroactively.

source.originalText: Exsanguinate: Violently extract blood from a target, dealing heavy damage to bleeding enemies and generating additional Blood Gauge.

cards.name: Veinweave: Blood Frenzy
cards.effect: Start Blood Frenzy Veinweave: once on your turn add S d6 to one weapon hit; gain+10 ft Speed and suffer-2 AC. No extra attacks, Actions or critical range. Ending early removes both benefit and penalty.

source.originalText: Veinweave: Blood Frenzy: Consume 3 Blood Gauge points to enter a frenzied state, increasing damage and attack speed but reducing defense.

cards.name: Blood Boil
cards.duration: Instant; control until end next turn
cards.effect: CON save: (S+1)d6 fire, half on success. On failure target loses Reactions; on failure by 10 also Stunned until end its next turn. The Stun uses the shared hard-denial guard across all this character’s features. If this character already hard-denied that target this encounter, only damage and the non-hard-denial rider resolve.

source.originalText: Blood Boil: Cause a target's blood to heat rapidly, dealing internal damage and potentially stunning them.

cards.name: Crimson Harvest
cards.rangeAndTarget: One enemy in weapon reach at half HP or less
cards.effect: Make one weapon attack; on hit add S d8 damage. If this reduces it to 0, regain S+M HP and 1 BG within gain cap. No instant kill from a percentage threshold; summoned/allied/helpless creatures yield no recovery.

source.originalText: Crimson Harvest: Execute a heavily wounded target, restoring health and Blood Gauge based on the target's missing health.

cards.name: Bloodstorm
cards.rangeAndTarget: Moving 10 ft aura around self, up to 3 enemies per pulse
cards.effect: On start and each later paid pulse, targets make CON saves: S d6 necrotic, half on success; failure applies one Bleed. Maintenance costs Bonus Action+1 RP. Maximum 3 pulses. Once/turn your direct weapon attack against a creature in the storm adds 1 damage; storm/bleed damage gives no BG.

source.originalText: Bloodstorm: Ultimate ability that creates a swirling vortex of blood, dealing continuous damage to enemies and empowering your abilities.

completeCurrentEnvelope.authoringNotes: Provisional; notebook adversarial findings reconciled and source-preserving editorial review complete. Human balance testing remains.

completeCurrentEnvelope.protectedInterfaceOriginal: If the Dragoon moved at least 20 feet before a Weave cast, reduce that cast's Dissonance gain by 1 (minimum 0); Momentum carries the note through motion.
completeCurrentEnvelope.rpAuthority: Explicit fallback: Cleric CoreV2 curve ×0.35, halves upward
engine: Strength is the class ability. Momentum starts/ends encounters at 0; cap 5, rising to 7 with Momentum Overflow or automatically at class 9. On each regular turn, moving at least 15 ft under your own power grants 1 Momentum, and damaging an enemy with a weapon attack grants 1 more. These are the only default gains; all gains/refunds together cap 2 per round. Forced movement, teleportation, movement in place, allies and summons cannot farm Momentum. Movement counts actual path traveled toward a tactical destination; one threshold per turn.

A leap technique moves you through an unobstructed arc to a visible unoccupied landing space within its range, adjacent to its target when attacking. Land during the same activation. It spends movement equal to horizontal distance, unless the card expressly supplies additional movement. A leap never gives flight, indefinite airborne immunity or free attacks. You cannot leap through ceilings/walls; vertical height is at most half the printed horizontal range. Safe technique landings do not cause self-fall damage; interrupted/falling travel follows ordinary falling rules. No bonus damage is earned by repeatedly dropping from a ledge.

All attack cards use a wielded polearm unless they explicitly describe a non-weapon save effect. A technique is its own Action, not an Attack Action plus free technique. At class 5 your ordinary Attack Action makes two attacks, at most two even when multiclass features overlap; each technique still gives only printed attacks. This automatic Extra Attack is a new explicit advancement specification for the pilot.

Armor bypass means the exact printed attack bonus or resistance exception, never subtracting a percentage of the target's whole AC. Critical ranges do not stack. A Dragoon can use only one free/Bonus Action leap granted by class features per round; it cannot trigger another free leap. Extra full Actions share the suite-wide cap. Reaction intercepts require a legal path and destination and do not rewind resolved damage.

Spending Momentum pays before resolution; a hit refund cannot pay its own activation. Burn means 1d4 fire at start of target's next 2 turns, nonstacking. Bleed means 1d4 physical at start of next 2 turns; an Action with a healer's kit ends it. Do Ts give no Momentum or critical triggers. Hard denial uses the shared once-per-target/encounter guard.

When casting an ordinary spell after moving at least 20 ft this turn, reduce that cast's Dissonance gain by 1, minimum 0; no automatic RP discount. Dragoon techniques are martial unless their card specifies elemental magic. Use Core V 2 RP and the Dragoon rank gates for separate spellcasting.

Use scheduled Base/Arch/Hero choices. Skybound Assault, Momentum Engine and related passives improve the automatic engine rather than unlock basic movement or generation. Lancer's Apex is automatic 9; at 10 choose Dragon Guardian, Drake Rider or Dragon Tyrant. The corresponding Final Flight is automatic 20. Apex Assault is an active technique despite its source passive heading.
workedExample: Dragoon 5, STR 16, PB 3, S 2, M 3; start Momentum 0. Know Dragon Leap, Momentum Surge, Wyvern's Guard and Draconic Roar at 1; Momentum Engine and Draconic Discipline at 2; Dragonflight and Momentum Overflow at 3. Capacity 7.
Turn 1: Dragon Leap spends 0 Momentum and moves 20 ft of Speed 30. Weapon attack hits: movement+hit each gain 1, ending 2. It rolls weapon damage+2d6. Land immediately.

Turn 2: Bonus Action Momentum Surge spends 2, balance 0, increases movement. Move 20 ft and use ordinary Attack Action: first successful hit and movement return 2 total, even if both attacks hit. End 2.
Turn 3: Dragonflight costs 2, balance 0. It supplies movement up to 60 ft as part of the Action; hit and movement regain 2 within the common cap. End 2; no additional normal Attack Action.
Turn 4: if knocked prone, use Aerial Recovery only if known and your Reaction is available. Its 1 Momentum still counts toward the round gain cap. A second refund cannot exceed 2 total gains.
End encounter: Momentum 0. RP, per-rest uses and other party resources do not refill.
balanceQuestions: Does Momentum stay available without trivial back-and-forth movement?
Do Guardian intercepts compete fairly for Reactions?
Are Tyrant area attacks and Rider extra Actions bounded at high level?

cards.name: Skybound Assault
cards.rangeAndTarget: One target hit by your leap
cards.effect: After a leap moves at least 15 ft and its attack hits, add S damage. Its hit grants ordinary Momentum, not an extra point. This benefit cannot trigger from forced movement or a leap granted by this same feature.

source.originalText: Skybound Assault: Leap to a target and deal +25% damage. Grants 1 Momentum.

cards.name: Draconic Discipline
cards.effect: Gain advantage on saves against being knocked Prone or forcibly moved. It does not protect against Stunned, spell damage or grappling unless the save also imposes one of those named effects.

source.originalText: Draconic Discipline: Gain +10% resistance to knockback and crowd control.

cards.name: Momentum Engine
cards.effect: After your first 15 ft of voluntary movement generates Momentum, ignore the next 5 ft of nonmagical difficult terrain this turn. The movement threshold itself is automatic class engine; this feature does not create another gain trigger.

source.originalText: Momentum Engine: Movement of 3+ tiles in a turn grants 1 Momentum (Max 5).

cards.name: Dragoon's Reach
cards.effect: Increase your wielded polearm's reach by 5 ft, maximum 15 ft. Once/own turn a natural 19 polearm attack that hits critically hits. It does not extend the range of other abilities or stack with another critical-range expansion.

source.originalText: Dragoon's Reach: Polearm attacks strike 1 tile further and have +5% crit chance.

cards.name: Aerial Poise
cards.effect: When a ranged attack hits you during your leap movement, halve its damage. You must spend the Reaction before damage resolves. Remaining airborne between turns cannot be declared to keep this protection active.

source.originalText: Aerial Poise: While airborne, take 25% reduced damage from ranged attacks.

cards.name: Dragon Leap
cards.rangeAndTarget: One polearm enemy at landing point within 30 ft
cards.effect: Leap, spending normal movement, then make one polearm attack. On hit add S d6 weapon-type damage. Legal movement and a hit may each grant 1 Momentum under the common cap. Land immediately; height never adds unbounded damage.

source.originalText: Dragon Leap: Launch yourself into the air and come crashing down on a target up to 30 feet away, dealing damage based on your Strength and height.

cards.name: Piercing Thrust
cards.effect: Make one polearm attack with+2 to the attack roll. On hit add S d4 weapon damage. This is the complete armor-piercing benefit; no percentage of AC is removed and critical range is unchanged.

source.originalText: Piercing Thrust: A powerful spear attack that partially ignores enemy armor and has increased critical hit chance.

cards.name: Wyvern's Guard
cards.effect: The next attack that damages you has damage reduced by S d6+M, minimum 0; then the guard ends. Roll the reduction only when damage occurs. This reduction cannot heal or reflect damage.

source.originalText: Wyvern's Guard: Enter a defensive stance that increases your resistance to damage from the next attack.

cards.name: Momentum Surge
cards.effect: Gain+15 ft Speed and+1 on your next polearm attack this turn. Spend before moving; movement may then generate normal Momentum. Grants no attack, extra Action, Bonus Action or Reaction.

source.originalText: Momentum Surge: Consume 2 Momentum to gain a burst of speed and +1 to your next attack roll.

cards.name: Draconic Roar
cards.rangeAndTarget: Up to 3 enemies and 3 allies within 15 ft that hear you
cards.effect: Enemies make WIS saves; failure Frightened of you. Chosen allies gain advantage on their next save against Frightened before duration ends. A creature may repeat the WIS save at its turn end, ending fear on success.

source.originalText: Draconic Roar: Release a intimidating battle cry that can frighten weaker enemies and rally allies.

cards.name: Crater Strike
cards.rangeAndTarget: Up to 2 enemies within 5 ft of your leap landing
cards.effect: After your leap attack hits, optionally pay 1; each selected adjacent enemy makes STR save or falls Prone. No additional weapon damage or Momentum gain. Landing on an occupied space is not permitted.

source.originalText: Crater Strike: Leap attack that applies knockdown in a small AoE.

cards.name: Momentum Overflow
cards.effect: Momentum cap becomes 7 early; cap becomes 7 for all Dragoons at 9. When starting a weapon technique with 6 or 7 Momentum, its first hit adds 1d6 damage before costs are deducted. Once/own turn, not per point above 5; no stored overflow beyond 7.

source.originalText: Momentum Overflow: Exceed Momentum cap (Max 7), bonus damage scales with overflow.

cards.name: Piercing Howl
cards.effect: Your next polearm attack gains+2 to hit and ignores resistance to its weapon damage type. Immunity remains. It does not ignore shields, natural armor, cover or arbitrary halves of AC.

source.originalText: Piercing Howl: Next polearm strike ignores 50% armor.

cards.name: Lance Tempo
cards.effect: After moving 15 ft voluntarily, gain+1 AC. If you critically hit with a polearm that turn, add 1d6 weapon damage once. The added die does not double itself or create further critical triggers.

source.originalText: Lance Tempo: If you moved this turn, gain +10% evasion and +10% crit damage.

cards.name: Wyvern's Flow
cards.rangeAndTarget: Self after a damaging leap hit
cards.effect: Regain 1 Momentum within the total 2-per-round gain cap, and shorten one OTHER positive leap cooldown by 1. Shortening uses that ability's reset allowance. No free leap or Action follows.

source.originalText: Wyvern's Flow: Successful leaps refund 1 Momentum and reduce next cooldown by 1.

cards.name: Apex Assault
cards.rangeAndTarget: One enemy in polearm reach after leap up to 30 ft
cards.effect: Spend K Momentum and leap using normal movement. Make one polearm attack; on hit add min(K, 5)d6 weapon damage. On a miss no bonus damage; expenditure remains. Gains from this activation cannot exceed the common cap.

source.originalText: Apex Assault: Ultimate leap: high damage finisher that consumes all Momentum.

cards.name: Lancer's Apex
cards.cost: All Momentum at current maximum; 1 short-rest use
cards.effect: Before paying the leap's Momentum cost, spend all maximum Momentum instead and use that leap as a Bonus Action, still paying other costs. It cannot trigger another free leap. Damage and hit generation use ordinary caps; this grants no extra Bonus Action.

source.originalText: Capstone – Lancer's Apex: Leap attacks now cost no action if performed at max Momentum (1/encounter).

cards.name: Dragonflight
cards.rangeAndTarget: One enemy adjacent to landing within 60 ft
cards.effect: Leap up to 60 ft as additional movement supplied by this Action. Make one polearm attack on landing; on hit add(S+1)d6 weapon damage. No damage scaling from distance/height and no remaining flight.

source.originalText: Dragonflight: An enhanced leap ability that allows you to jump twice as high and far, with increased damage based on distance traveled.

cards.name: Spear Cyclone
cards.rangeAndTarget: Up to 3 distinct enemies in polearm reach
cards.effect: Make one polearm attack against each. No target is attacked twice. Hit-based Momentum can be gained only once this turn regardless of number of hits; movement and refund caps still apply.

source.originalText: Spear Cyclone: Spin your polearm in a wide arc, striking all enemies within range and building Momentum for each hit.

cards.name: Momentum Burst
cards.effect: Spend K Momentum. Next polearm hit this turn adds min(K, 4)d6 weapon damage. If the next attack misses the effect ends. It does not widen critical range or multiply another added damage package.

source.originalText: Momentum Burst: Consume all Momentum to gain a significant boost to your next attack's damage and critical hit chance.

cards.name: Aerial Recovery
cards.rangeAndTarget: Self just knocked Prone or pushed
cards.effect: After the triggering displacement resolves, stand from Prone without movement cost and move 5 ft to an unoccupied space without provoking opportunity attacks. Gain 1 Momentum within the round cap. Cannot prevent falling without a legal landing.

source.originalText: Aerial Recovery: After being knocked down or back, instantly regain your footing and gain 1 Momentum.

cards.name: Dragon's Eye
cards.effect: Study it: your first polearm attack against it has advantage, and you learn one of its visible damage resistances if any. No automatic critical, secret full stat block or ability to attack through cover.

source.originalText: Dragon's Eye: Briefly gain the keen vision of a dragon, allowing you to spot weaknesses in enemy defenses and increase your critical hit range.

cards.name: Aegis Leap
cards.rangeAndTarget: Ally within 15 ft targeted by an attack
cards.effect: Before the attack roll, leap to an empty space adjacent to ally using this supplied movement. Become the target if the attack can reach you; resolve against your AC. Cannot be used if restrained or no path. Counts as your one intercept reaction.

source.originalText: Aegis Leap: Leap to an ally and intercept the next attack made against them.

cards.name: Wyrmhide
cards.rangeAndTarget: Self while above half maximum HP
cards.effect: Reduce each damage instance by 2 and gain advantage on CON saves against Bleed, Burn and Poisoned. No blanket condition immunity; effects already present persist and ordinary nonstacking reduction applies.

source.originalText: Wyrmhide: Gain +10% DR and immunity to Bleed/Burn/Poison while above 50% HP.

cards.name: Momentum Shield
cards.effect: After spending at least 1 Momentum, gain temporary HP equal to amount spent+M, maximum 10. Later expenditure replaces with the higher remaining value; no real HP restoration.

source.originalText: Momentum Shield: Spending Momentum grants temporary HP.

cards.name: Spiral Defense
cards.rangeAndTarget: Melee attacker in polearm reach that misses you while at maximum Momentum
cards.effect: Make one polearm attack. Pay Momentum after checking the maximum prerequisite. This counter grants no Momentum and cannot trigger another counter or leap. It consumes your ordinary Reaction.

source.originalText: Spiral Defense: Automatically counter melee attacks with a polearm when at max Momentum.

cards.name: Bastion Descent
cards.rangeAndTarget: Leap within 30 ft; up to 6 allies within 15 ft of landing
cards.duration: Instant; protection until start next turn
cards.effect: Land in empty space. Chosen allies gain 4d8+M temporary HP and may end Frightened or Poisoned. They gain resistance to the next damage instance before your next turn. No healing, resurrection or removal of Wounds.

source.originalText: Final Flight – Bastion Descent: Slam down between allies, cleansing effects and shielding the group.

cards.name: Guardian's Intercept
cards.rangeAndTarget: Ally within 30 ft being hit by an attack
cards.effect: Leap adjacent before damage, becoming the target of that already successful hit; halve damage to you after normal mitigation. No new roll against your AC. Requires legal path/landing. You cannot also use Aegis Leap on the same attack.

source.originalText: Guardian's Intercept: Leap to an ally's position and take the next attack targeted at them, with reduced damage to yourself.

cards.name: Draconic Ward
cards.rangeAndTarget: Self and up to 3 allies within 10 ft
cards.effect: Project a ward: chosen creatures while within 10 ft reduce damage by S, minimum 0. The reduction does not stack with Wyrmhide or another flat class reduction. No passive healing or extra Actions.

source.originalText: Draconic Ward: Channel draconic energy to create a protective aura around yourself and nearby allies, reducing incoming damage.

cards.name: Wyrmscale Defense
cards.effect: Gain resistance to bludgeoning, piercing and slashing and advantage on saves against Poisoned, Frightened and Stunned. This is not immunity; existing conditions still require their ordinary removal.

source.originalText: Wyrmscale Defense: Temporarily harden your skin like dragon scales, gaining significant damage reduction and status effect resistance.

cards.name: Momentum Barrier
cards.effect: Spend K Momentum. Each gains K+S d6 temporary HP, using one shared dice roll. These HP do not stack with other shields and no unspent Momentum remains. This is not concentration.

source.originalText: Momentum Barrier: Convert your Momentum into a protective shield that absorbs damage for you and nearby allies.

cards.name: Dragon's Sanctuary
cards.rangeAndTarget: Fixed 15 ft-radius zone centered within 30 ft; up to 6 allies
cards.effect: Chosen allies inside reduce damage by 5 and have advantage against Frightened/Charmed. On start and each of your next 2 turns, Bonus Action lets one ally inside repeat one save against a present Frightened, Charmed or Poisoned effect. No automatic mass cleanse each turn.

source.originalText: Dragon's Sanctuary: Ultimate ability that creates a zone of protection, significantly reducing damage to all allies within range and cleansing negative effects.

cards.name: Drake Mark
cards.rangeAndTarget: One creature hit by your leap
cards.effect: Mark that creature; your first subsequent direct polearm hit adds S damage. A new mark replaces old. No extra damage to the triggering leap, Do Ts or copies; it is not a spell mark.

source.originalText: Drake Mark: Each leap attack marks enemies. Marked enemies take +10% damage from you.

cards.name: Elemental Spearcraft
cards.effect: Choose fire, cold or lightning. Once/own turn one polearm hit adds 1d6 chosen damage. Switching requires a new activation and full cost. Does not stack with Elemental Lance's bonus; use stronger.

source.originalText: Elemental Spearcraft: Infuse polearms with Fire, Ice, or Lightning for 3 turns (switchable).

cards.name: Air Mastery
cards.effect: Increase leap range by 10 ft, not vertical ceiling penetration or flight. After a successful leap hit, shorten one OTHER positive leap cooldown by 1 using its reset allowance. Does not combine with Wyvern's Flow on the same counter in a round.

source.originalText: Air Mastery: Gain +20% jump range and 10% reduced cooldown on leap skills.

cards.name: Momentum Tempo
cards.rangeAndTarget: Self after spending at least 3 Momentum on a technique this turn
cards.effect: Pay 3 additional Momentum now to gain one extra full Action on your next turn. Shared cap applies; it cannot grant another Action or another Momentum Tempo. Triggering technique must have been paid without this additional cost. No queued actions.

source.originalText: Momentum Tempo: After spending 3+ Momentum in a round, gain an extra action next turn.

cards.name: Drakestorm Dive
cards.rangeAndTarget: Leap up to 60 ft; up to 6 enemies within 15 ft of landing
cards.effect: Choose fire/cold/lightning. DEX save:6d8 chosen damage, half on success. On failure fire applies Burn, cold reduces Speed 10 ft until end next turn, lightning prevents Reactions until then. Land in legal empty space; no additional weapon attack.

source.originalText: Final Flight – Drakestorm Dive: Choose an element and leap into a group, triggering a large AoE blast.

cards.name: Elemental Lance
cards.effect: Choose fire/cold/lightning. Once/own turn a hit adds S d4 damage; fire adds 1 damage, cold reduces target Speed 5 ft until end next turn, lightning denies opportunity attacks until start its next turn. Nonstacking with Spearcraft; one element rider/turn.

source.originalText: Elemental Lance: Infuse your weapon with elemental energy (fire, ice, or lightning), adding additional damage and effects to your attacks.

cards.name: Drake's Agility
cards.effect: Gain+20 ft Speed and may replace 10 ft of normal movement with a leap of 10 ft horizontally/5 ft vertically. This is movement only, not another leap attack or technique. No new Action or attack is granted.

source.originalText: Drake's Agility: Channel the speed of a drake, significantly increasing your movement speed and allowing an additional leap this turn.

cards.name: Aerial Combo
cards.rangeAndTarget: Up to 2 enemies adjacent to legal landings within 30 ft
cards.effect: Leap to first target, attack once, then leap up to 15 ft to second and attack once. All movement supplied by Action; two attacks maximum even with Extra Attack. Add 1d6 to each hit. Only one hit-generated Momentum per turn.

source.originalText: Aerial Combo: Perform a rapid series of attacks while airborne, building and consuming Momentum with each strike.

cards.name: Elemental Adaptation
cards.effect: Choose fire/cold/lightning: gain resistance to that type and may convert normal polearm weapon damage to it. This adds no damage and cannot combine with another resistance multiplicatively. Choice fixed for duration.

source.originalText: Elemental Adaptation: Temporarily gain resistance to a chosen element and infuse your attacks with that element.

cards.name: Drakestorm
cards.rangeAndTarget: Moving 10 ft aura; up to 3 enemies per pulse
cards.effect: Choose element. Start and on each of next 2 turns, Bonus Action pulses S d6 damage, DEX half. During duration Speed+10 ft. No free weapon attacks or Momentum from pulse damage; maximum 3 pulses.

source.originalText: Drakestorm: Ultimate ability that summons a swirling storm of elemental energy around you, dealing damage to nearby enemies and enhancing your mobility.

cards.name: Tyrant's Crash
cards.rangeAndTarget: Up to 2 enemies within 5 ft of your leap landing
cards.effect: After a leap hit pay 1. Targets make WIS save; on failure Frightened and-1 AC. Save repeated at each turn end ends both. This neither stacks AC penalties nor affects enemies beyond the printed area.

source.originalText: Tyrant's Crash: Leap attack applies Fear and Sunder Armor in an AoE.

cards.name: Momentum Feeder
cards.rangeAndTarget: Self on polearm critical or hostile kill
cards.effect: Gain 2 Momentum, still within total 2-per-round gain cap. A critical kill is one trigger, not two. Do Ts, copies, allies, summons and helpless creatures cannot trigger it.

source.originalText: Momentum Feeder: Killing or critting grants +2 Momentum.

cards.name: Wyrmblood Surge
cards.effect: After spending Momentum, your next direct polearm hit adds damage equal to points spent, maximum 5. Further spending replaces rather than adds this bonus. It is flat damage and grants no resource refund.

source.originalText: Wyrmblood Surge: Each Momentum spent grants +5% damage for the next 2 turns.

cards.name: Skypiercer Stance
cards.effect: Increase leap vertical clearance allowance by 10 ft, never through solid obstacles. Once/own turn a natural 19 polearm hit critically hits; use the broadest critical range rather than stacking. It does not let you remain flying.

completeCurrentEnvelope.protectedInterfaceOriginal: A Nuke Chain requires different named spells of the chosen element; completing a three-spell chain vents 2 Dissonance. Repeating one nuke builds Refrain normally.
engine: PROVISIONAL PLAYTEST CONTRACT. Intelligence is the Mage class ability. S = 1/2/3/4 at Mage levels 1/5/11/17. M = max(1, Intelligence modifier) unless a feature explicitly says otherwise.
